def apply_pair_fill_bg(grid, pair, source, target, bg):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=set().union(*[set(s) for s in pair])
    rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
    fill=bg if target==0 else target
    for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
        for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1): out[r][c]=fill
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=source
    return out
